messages:
elaine (sales): POC kickoff with Pangaea tomorrow. They want us to validate a custom Llama50B-derived variant (LoRA fused) with 4-bit quantization on Dedicated. Key asks: latency SLO ~150ms p95, KV cache for ~64k context use, KMS/HSM for model keys, and answers for their SOC2-ish questionnaire. Also need a rough pricing delta vs hosted. Who can own model compatibility scan + security prefill?
marc (solutions): I can own the tech triage. Can you get the model artifact (checkpoint + config + tokenizer) and a couple sample prompt flows? Also need expected qps and traffic bursts.
elaine (sales): attaching model transfer link (internal) + sample prompts. They expect ~30 qps baseline with short bursts to 120 qps. I'll DM creds.
jeff (eng-runtime): quick notes: we generally support Llama-style checkpoints. If the LoRA is fused into the checkpoint we just need model config to confirm layer ordering. 4-bit quant (q4_0/q4_k) path depends on kernel availability; some 4-bit flavors fall back to CPU which will blow latency. For Dedicated we can precompile kernels and pin model variant. Can you also confirm vocab/tokenizer format (sentencepiece vs bpe)?
marc (solutions): tokenizer is sentencepiece (they said). I'll add that to the artifacts.
tay (security): KMS is straightforward in Dedicated; HSM adds procurement/ops complexity. Send over the questionnaire — we can prefill standard answers for our Dedicated offering and flag anything that needs customer-side attestation. Also need to know data residency requirements for POC.
elaine (sales): questionnaire link here: https://shared.internal/pangaea-sec-qna (placeholder). Client wants data kept in eu-west. POC should run in our eu-west Dedicated pool.
alex (finance): rough pricing note: for a 50B-class quantized model on Dedicated the unit economics depend heavily on sustained tokens and GPU SKU. For 30 qps @ ~600 tokens/request expect X compute-hours/day — I'll put together a 7-day POC estimate (trial credits for the first week + a short reserved commit if they want predictable pricing).
marc (solutions): To be explicit on compatibility checks I'll run our automated model-variant scan (memory footprint, KV cache layout, rmsnorm/scale differences, tokenizer mismatch, perf regression against our reference). ETA 24-48h once we have the artifact. Command I usually run: ```
# run variant scan
ri model-scan --model-path /tmp/pangaea/checkpoint --tokenizer /tmp/pangaea/tokenizer.model --output /tmp/pangaea/scan-report.json
```
jeff (eng-runtime): Add to that: test harness should include long-context prefix replay to validate KV caching offsets. If LoRA was fused post-quantization there can be ordering differences that break cache indexing. Also we need to verify attention kernel supports sequence lengths they expect (~64k). If not, fallback latency will be >500ms.
sarah (cs): I can schedule the POC slot in eu-west tomorrow 10:00 CET and coordinate access. Will invite Pangaea engineers + our solutions + runtime.
elaine (sales): thanks — please include a quick FAQs doc for the client: what we need from them (model tarball, sample prompt flows, expected latency per interaction, data residency confirmation).
marc (solutions): noted. I'll also run a lightweight sanity test on quantized vs fp16 to give them a quality delta (perplexity/sample output).
jeff (eng-runtime): FYI if they insist on HSM for keys we need legal/ops ok — that pushes timeline. KMS is normally fine for POC.
tay (security): I'll start filling the questionnaire. For the SOC2 items we can provide our standard answers and mark the Dedicated-specific controls where we need the customer's acceptance.
alex (finance): I'll drop a provisional cost sheet in the thread by EOD with two scenarios: pure hosted (usage) vs Dedicated (monthly commit + overage).
deploy-bot: dedicated-cluster:eu-west: created cluster pangaea-poc-2024-05-19 (id: dc-8792) :rocket:
sarah (cs): cluster ready and access sent to client.
elaine (sales): perfect — team, let's follow up after the scan results. POC kickoff tomorrow 10:00 CET. :thumbsup:
